limits: Operator new and operator delete use the comparison heap.
CRT fseek and fread are scripted platform boundaries reached through unchanged original resource-data helpers.
Cases disable reporter output flags so its nested CRT formatting and UI paths stay outside this comparison.
DirectSound methods and stream retry methods are supplied by case vtables.
notes: The canonical module preserves original token ABI alongside the existing portable legacy source. Historical legacy measurement reported nine inferred entries; acquisition 0x4b61c0, release 0x4b6230 and stream 0x4b7ab0 already belong to canonical resource_data and execute as unchanged original dependencies. Only the five reviewed PCM/sound entry addresses are owned here. CRT/platform code stays outside recovery. Creator/parser and concrete destruction delegates execute as unchanged original code rather than fixtures. Canonical source-only status does not replace the legacy app integration claim.
